Results.ReviewText: This grill is made of extremely high quality materials, very thoughtful and useful features.  Love the hook to hang the lid on the side of the grill, and the ash catcher at the bottom makes it usable on my wooden deck.
Results.Title: Really great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great quality and a good price! Perfect addition to my new back yard
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s a good simple charcoal grill. The only downside is the thermometer is practically useless.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: I've owned Weber Kettle grills for over 45 years. I've owned at least 4 over that time and given several as presents to friends and family. I smoked my first brisket on one, smoked turkeys, hams, chickens, and many burgers, sausages, fish fillets, chicken parts, etc over the years. There have been feature changes on the grill but the Weber Kettle design and ease to use is the same. I've always had one in my collection (with stick burners, gas grills, pellet smokers, water smokers, etc) and they always come through. Easy to light, clean burning, easy to control temperatures, and always great tasting food.
Results.Title: A grill for the ages

Results.ReviewText:
Just sold my old genesis silver.
Still have my genesis 330 
Just purchased a beauitful gold kettle premium. I'm a Weber man for life. Keep up the quality guys!
Results.Title: Great quality grills

Results.ReviewText: This was an upgrade for me from a much cheaper kettle grill that I had been using for a few years. What surprised me was just how big of an upgrade it is! Each component is of superior quality, and fits together very well! I appreciate how functional each piece is with utensil hooks on the handles, and the grate handles that allow you hang it from the side of the grill. My only complaint is that the charcoal grate allows smaller pieces of lump charcoal through. This is easily solved by getting a second charcoal grate and laying it on top of the first. I am also very happy with the number of aftermarket accessories available!
Results.Title: The Benchmark All Kettles Are Measured By

Results.ReviewText: Every grill I own is a Weber.  Why?  Because they have the best customer service hands down, and quality grills.  I have a Genesis gas grill, Smokey Joe, Go Anywhere, 22 inch kettle and today a 22 inch Weber Smokey Mountain is being delivered.  Pricey?  A little bit, but they come with a 10 year no hassle warranty.  You're gonna pay for quality or buy junk and toss it at the end of grilling season.  Up to you.
Results.Title: Weber grill on your mind?  Just buy it!

Results.ReviewText: So far so good, We’ve gone through steaks, chicken and even a pizza! This little fellow is sturdy and retains heat like a champ.
Results.Title: Grill grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill - I’d opt for the hinged lid next time
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great my last one lasted 25 years and this one I expect the same and love some of the new features
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I'm 40. I've cooked on charcoal for over 20 years, and never owned a weber grill, because it costs a bit more than others. Wow, I regret that. It's the best grill I've ever cooked on. I didn't know what I missing until this grill. It controls the heat better than anything I've used before. Built very well too, clean-up is a breeze.
Results.Title: Waited too long

Results.ReviewText: great grill, my first charcoal one. Steaks just got way better:P and its built to last
Results.Title: A must have!

Results.ReviewText: Just can't beat a Weber!  Craftsmanship, well built and sturdy.  There are countless number of accessories and modifications that can be made.  The Weber community is tremendous, therefore providing ingenious ideas for cooking and managing your grill/smoker/griddle/rotisserie/etc.
Results.Title: Just can't beat a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I’m liking the 22” kettle grill. I would love the grill if the lid stayed on tighter. I move the grill around and the lid falls off if I’m not holding it.
Results.Title: Fix that lid

Results.ReviewText: Over all good product, but not the same quality as in older units.
Results.Title: Webber grills

Results.ReviewText:
Weber kettle bbqs are amazing.  They are easy to use and control.  I gave my gas grill away!
No need for a rotisserie. Convection cooking for roasts, turkeys, planked salmon etc etc.
Or direct heat for mouthwatering steaks, chicken etc.
AND they offer a 10 year guarantee!!  You won’t need it because they just won’t die, rust out etc.!
Great value for a quality product!!
Results.Title: Awesome!

Results.ReviewText: i replaced an original 22 in kettle charcoal grill that i have had for 10 years. this is a great grill.
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s the best in charcoal grills. It’s worth the extra money to upgrade to this model.
Results.Title: Premium charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s the most versatile charcoal grill made for grilling and smoking.
Results.Title: The best charcoal grill made!

Results.ReviewText: Just bought this one, but have been using Weber 22" grill my entire life. Great as always! Easy to put together and start up for the first time.
Results.Title: Perfect Steaks every time

Results.ReviewText: I tried a gas grill for a few years and didn't much care for it. I love the simplicity of the Weber Kettle grill. I am also finding it very versatile. I have smoked a pork shoulder on it all day that turned out fantastic.
Results.Title: Back to charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: Spacious enough to grill plenty of keg quarters or a decent size brisket. Solid construction and one touch cleaning system is a wonderful tool
Results.Title: Ol faithful

Results.ReviewText: My Kettle 22 is by far the best grill for the money on the planet! Easy to use, cooking great steaks and hamburgers. And when you are done cleanup is a snap.
Results.Title: My new Weber Kettle 22

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber, and I’ll be buying them for life. Always super impressed with the capabilities of these bells.
Results.Title: Amazing bell

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill and should be for the price. I love the option to grill or smoke. Only changes I would like to see is clear markings on the bottom vent lever to show open, 75%, 50%, 25%, closed. That prevent having to open the lid or look from the bottom. A sharpie does the trick but markings are something that would be easy enough to have already on the product.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText:
I have grilled on Webbers for over 25-years. At least four grills that I have worn out ( a good thing)
I have a complaint with the new grill I purchased this month in that Webber has eliminated the second handle on the grill. This means once the grill has fired up it cannot be lifted safely. A HUGH disadvantage with the only benefit that Webber saves a few dollars at a disadvantage to its loyal customers.
Results.Title: 22" premium grill

Results.ReviewText: We just bought a new Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill.  We love it so far.  My family has always had a Weber grill my entire life, so I knew I'd like it.  We wanted  a new one to replace an electric grill we got because of where we were living.  Happy to have a charcoal grill again.  The new features are very nice, especially the ash collector, a great innovation.  The hinged grill is also great.  The only con, if I even would call it that, is that I do wish it was just a bit taller, but that's a minor complaint.
Results.Title: New Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill works great worth the money good quality. Cooked T-Bone and baked potato on it. Came out perfect.
Results.Title: 22" original premium charcoal grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are excited to hear you are enjoying the improvements made to the Original Kettle legs and the damper shield on the lid. We will pass along your feedback regarding one handle on the bowl. Our support team at Weber is always happy to assist if needed by phone at 800-446-1071 or by email at support@weberstephen.com. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: This is my third kettle over the years. The legs are held in by pins which is a great improvement. They stopped putting the handle on both sides of the grill which makes it harder to move. The handle shield on top does it's job and the handle stays cool.
Results.Title: Some Good and some Bad

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber grills and this one is so easy to clean. I have no complaints.
Results.Title: Easy clean

Results.ReviewText: Trusted name, trusted product.  I've bought this kettle grill/smoker for over 40 years.  It has taught me a lot.  And fed us well!  Few things that are superior at the start remain unchanged through the years.  This, however, has remained basically the same through the years, and still produces great grilling.  Thanks.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: One of the best charcoal grills out there. Quality Weber craftsmanship. Highly recommend this grill to those looking to grill up some great tasting food!!
Results.Title: One of the best!!

Results.ReviewText: If you don’t own a Weber kettle then You need to buy this. You will never use your propane grill again. I cook everything from burgers to smoking a pork butt all day. This is the best all around product you can buy, especially at the price point. You won’t regret it.
Results.Title: Buy it

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, very efficient. Went with another brand for a while but came back to a weber
Results.Title: Back to a weber

Results.ReviewText: There are a number of improvements over the older models, such as the lid and cooking grate feature that allows for hanging them on the grill itself. I also like the ability to add charcoal without removing the cooking grate. The not thing I’m a little disappointed with is, the unit doesn’t seem to be as tight as my older grill. The lid doesn’t fit as tight, allowing smoke to escape around the rim.
Results.Title: New features

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are consistently top of the line. The Original 22” Kettle is no exception.
Results.Title: Consistent quality

Results.ReviewText: I use mesquite only when I grill. The Original Kettle Premium meets my expectations for  straightforward no nonsense right way to grill everything from steak to veggies. Kuddos to simplicity and tradition.
Results.Title: Kuddos to simplicity and tradition

Results.ReviewText: Love it...best grill I’ve had for the money and so easy to clean and maintain.
Results.Title: Original kettle premium charcoal grill best grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect traditional charcoal grill! Works great and goes well with my smoker!
Results.Title: Perfect Charcoal Grill

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
